extras: Free for 14 days, then requires a one-time purchase. The plugin is private and collects no data.
intentEvidence: Write in your Obsidian vault with Apple Pencil.
problem: Users need a way to capture handwritten notes and annotations using Apple Pencil that remain accessible and integrated within their local Obsidian vault structure.

relations.evidence: Inkidian is a native iPad app for handwritten notes and PDF annotation.

summary: Inkidian allows users to capture handwritten notes and annotate PDFs using Apple Pencil on an iPad, saving them as local files within the Obsidian vault.
